title: Scaffold CMS App Pages
description: Scaffold the pages of an app into an existing cms_app (POST /admin/cms-apps/{id}/scaffold): one CMS entry list that holds the form (create_admin), a public read-only data view and its detail page (create_public).

base_name.description: Lowercase keyword base. Defaults to the app slug when omitted.

data_table.description: Existing data table name. Required unless create_form is true.

create_form.description: Put the inline form (and the fresh data table it owns) into the CMS list /cms/<base>. Requires create_admin. Default false.

style.description: image/files scaffold a file-input (single image or multi-file downloads, files_public=1).

with_status.description: Add a draft/published status field, CMS publish/unpublish quick actions, and a public fixed filter for published records. Default true.

create_public.description: Create the public list (a read-only data view) and the public detail page. Default true.

create_admin.description: Create the CMS list /cms/<base>: one entry list that shows, adds, edits, deletes and restores the records. Default true.
